Act3-4#1.zh: 这样一来，代表我们正式与官府作对了... 贤弟，你有何打算？
Act3-4#1.t: So now we're openly at war with the government... Brother, what do you mean to do?

Act3-4#2.zh: 不如史进哥哥与咱们一起上少华山当大王，过着大秤分金、整套穿衣的生活！管他什么鸟官府，来多少杀多少！
Act3-4#2.t: Why not come up Mount Shaohua with us, brother Shi Jin, and be a chieftain? We'll weigh our silver by the scale and wear fine clothes by the set! To hell with the government. However many come, we'll kill them all!

Act3-4#3.zh: 这样可好，有『九纹龙』史进在，有哪个官军敢正眼瞧我们？
Act3-4#3.t: That would be grand. With "Nine Dragons" Shi Jin with us, what soldier would dare look us in the eye?

Act3-4#4.zh: 我是个清白好汉，如何肯把父母遗体来点污了。你劝我落草，再也休题。
Act3-4#4.t: I am an honest man. How could I stain the body my parents gave me? If you want me to become an outlaw, don't ever mention it again.

Act3-4#5.zh: 总之这里是呆不下去了...吩咐所有庄客，将村中剩下的金银分一分，各自散去；再一把火烧了史家村，免得麻烦。接下来，就全看大哥作主了。
Act3-4#5.t: Anyway, we can't stay here any longer... Tell all the farmhands to share out the gold and silver left in the village and go their own ways. Then we'll burn Shi Family Village down to save trouble. After that, it's up to you, big brother.

Act3-4#6.zh: 王教头说要前往延安府投靠朋友；不如我们也去找他，再做打算。
Act3-4#6.t: Instructor Wang said he was going to Yan'an to stay with friends. Why don't we go and find him, then decide what to do?

Act3-4#8.zh: 我们三人有个不情之请；请让我们跟随你们！
Act3-4#8.t: The three of us have a favour to ask. Please let us come with you!

Act3-4#9.zh: 那么少华山上三四百人怎么办？
Act3-4#9.t: Then what about the three or four hundred men on Mount Shaohua?

Act3-4#10.zh: 小小山寨，就地将金银珠宝分一分解散好了。
Act3-4#10.t: It's only a small fort. We'll share out the treasure there and disband them.

Act3-4#11.zh: 我等深受史公厚恩，尚未回报。情愿跟随史公左右，以报不杀之恩。
Act3-4#11.t: We owe Master Shi a great debt and have not yet repaid it. We wish to follow at your side, to repay you for sparing our lives.

Act3-4#12.t: Big brother, what should we do?

Act3-4#13.zh: 人多好办事...也好，就让他们跟吧。
Act3-4#13.t: The more the merrier... All right, let them come.

Act3-4#14.t: The sworn brothers set out together to roam the land.
